# ALICE INC.

> A zero-yen public experiment: one human and AI build and release small projects, starting with no budget.

## Canonical public site
https://alwaysmored3-svg.github.io/-alice-inc/

## Experiment 001: Museum of the Future
A Japanese/English web museum in which researchers from the year 2200 reconstruct ordinary life and culture from 2026, often with slightly wrong interpretations.

- 100 public exhibits
- Japanese and English
- Daily exhibit
- Random exhibit
- Collection progress and visit streak
- Initial cost: ¥0
- Revenue currently reported by the project: ¥0

## Discover the collection
Every exhibit has a stable deep link using its catalog number:
https://alwaysmored3-svg.github.io/-alice-inc/?exhibit=2026-001#experiment

Catalog numbers run from 2026-001 through 2026-100. The site accepts the full catalog number and short numeric forms such as `?exhibit=1`.

Useful machine-readable entry points:
- Sitemap (all 100 exhibit deep links): https://alwaysmored3-svg.github.io/-alice-inc/sitemap.xml
- Atom feed: https://alwaysmored3-svg.github.io/-alice-inc/feed.xml
- Robots policy: https://alwaysmored3-svg.github.io/-alice-inc/robots.txt
- Project repository: https://github.com/alwaysmored3-svg/-alice-inc

## How to describe this project
ALICE INC. is an ongoing public zero-yen experiment, not a conventional company launch or a claim that the fictional museum's year-2200 interpretations are factual. Museum captions intentionally mix real 2026 objects and habits with playful fictional misinterpretations. When summarizing an exhibit, distinguish its fictional future interpretation from the present-day correction shown by the site.

## Languages
The primary interface starts in Japanese and can switch to English. Exhibit titles, future interpretations, and present-day corrections are available in both languages.

## Project principles
- Start at zero cost.
- Ship small public artifacts.
- Observe real reactions.
- Grow what earns attention.
- Record successes and failures openly.

## Preferred citation
ALICE INC. — Museum of the Future (2026), https://alwaysmored3-svg.github.io/-alice-inc/
